correctness.rationale: After damping only the 2x2 GHZ corner block carries a phase-dependent coherence sqrt(Q)/2; the SLD formula yields F=2n^2Q/(1+Q+R). For two coordinates of fixed sum s and product t, Q=C(1-s+t), R=Dt and d[(1+Dt)/(C(1-s+t))]/dt=[D(1-s)-1]/[C(1-s+t)^2]<0 throughout the interior, so equalization strictly raises F and yields the Schur-concavity/global extrema. At S<1 concentration (S,0,..,0) minimizes to 2n^2(1-S)/(2-S); S>=1 allows p_i=1 and zero QFI. The uniform F equals n at the unique monotone root; expansion follows from log and exponentially small (S/n)^n. Independent random pair-smoothing tests (30,000) and source block derivation agree; finite checks corroborate but do not prove arbitrary n.
